name: Signal
short_description: Check AI visibility, understand weaknesses, choose a change and measure what happens next.
long_description: Signal runs fresh GPT web-search tests to investigate how a public business appears for real customer questions. It saves raw answers and sources, separates name searches from neutral discovery, distinguishes observed gaps from possible explanations, and suggests specific interventions grounded in the evidence. Record a chosen change, repeat the same questions and compare mentions and recommendations before and after. Results show observed improvement, deterioration, mixed results or no clear change; they do not promise a permanent ranking or establish causal, demand or sales effects. Saved studies use private references; anyone with a reference can access that study.
starter_prompts: Check how my business appears for customer questions.
Why might my business not be surfacing, and what change should I test?
Repeat my saved questions and compare visibility after the change.
